cards.example_en: This scarf is made of soft wool from the farm.
cards.example_zh: 这条围巾是用农场出的柔软羊毛做的。

cards.example_en: She bought a woollen scarf to wear on the cold school trip.
cards.example_zh: 她买了一条羊毛围巾，准备在寒冷的学校旅行时戴。

cards.example_en: My father keeps a photo of our family at his workplace.
cards.example_zh: 我父亲在工作场所放着一张我们的全家福。

cards.example_en: Across the wet path, a worm crawled after the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 大雨过后，一条虫子爬过了湿漉漉的小路。
